intro.chords: D G A D G A D

verse1.chords: G A   D             G   A   D

verse1.lyrics: I have often dreamed, of a far off place
Where a hero's welcome, would be waiting for me

verse1.chords: G  A        D           G    A      Bm

verse1.lyrics: Where the crowds will cheer, when they see my face
And a voice keeps saying, this is where I'm meant to be

chorus1.lyrics: I'll be there someday, I can go the distance
I will find my way, if I can be strong
I know every mile, will be worth my while

chorus1.chords: G  A   D  A      Bm   A  G           A   D

chorus1.lyrics: When I go the distance, I'll be right where I belong

verse2.chords: G A     D          G  A     D

verse2.lyrics: Down an unknown road, to embrace my fate
Though that road may wander, it will lead me to you

verse2.chords: G A      D        G      A         Bm

verse2.lyrics: And a thousand years, would be worth the wait
It might take a lifetime, but somehow I'll see it through

chorus2.lyrics: And I won't look back, I can go the distance
And I'll stay on track, no, I won't accept defeat
It's an uphill slope, but I won't lose hope

chorus2.chords: G  A   D  A      Bm  A  G       A     D

chorus2.lyrics: Till I go the distance, and my journey is complete

bridge.lyrics: But to look beyond the glory is the hardest part
For a hero's strength is measured by his heart

chorus3.lyrics: Like a shooting star, I will go the distance
I will search the world, I will face its' harms
I don't care how far, I can go the distance

chorus3.chords: G    A  D A    Bm A     G       A       D

chorus3.lyrics: Till I find my hero's welcome, waiting in your arms

ending.lyrics: I will search the world, I will face it's harms

ending.chords: G    A  D A    Bm A     G       A       G A D

ending.lyrics: Till I find my hero's welcome, waiting in your arms
